on_battle_start: The hive works as one, and today, so do we. Welcome, challenger.
Every sting has a purpose. Let's see if you can handle mine.
on_battle_won: The swarm overwhelms another challenger. Return once you've grown.
The hive remains undefeated. Come back stronger, trainer.
on_battle_lost: You've bested the swarm itself. The Champion awaits you now.
Remarkable. The hive has never seen a trainer like you.
